meta_description:
136 likes, 6 comments - fintaxbynishant on September 18, 2026: "There’s a lot of noise around UPI charges right now, and most people are only seeing half the information.

The main confusion is simple...does the customer now have to pay extra while using UPI? No.

The new MDR rules apply on the merchant side for selected transactions.

So before believing random forwards or headlines, understand what MDR actually means and who pays it.

That’s what I’ve broken down in this post.

Save it and share it with someone who is still confused about the new UPI rules.
.
.
.
[UPI, Unified Payments Interface, Merchant Discount Rate, MDR, UPI 2026, Digital Payments, NPCI, Personal Finance, Financial Literacy, India Finance]

#UPI #MDR #DigitalPayments #PersonalFinance #FinTaxByNishant".
